SELECT v.id,v.user_id,v.real_name_ciphertext,v.id_card_ciphertext,v.encryption_key_version,v.id_card_front_object_key,v.id_card_back_object_key,v.submit_request_id,v.submitted_at,v.material_consent_version,v.material_consent_at,v.reviewed_by_admin_user_id,v.reviewed_at,v.audit_remark,v.version,v.verification_status,v.provider,v.provider_request_id,v.reject_reason,v.verified_at,v.created_at,v.updated_at FROM user_realname_verification v WHERE v.user_id=#{user} ORDER BY CASE WHEN verification_status IN ('pending','verified') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,submitted_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1

mapper.update: UPDATE user_realname_verification SET verification_status=#{status},reviewed_by_admin_user_id=#{actor},reviewed_at=#{now},updated_at=#{now},version=version+1,reject_reason=CASE WHEN #{status}='rejected' THEN #{remark} ELSE NULL END,audit_remark=#{remark},verified_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='verified' THEN #{now} ELSE NULL END WHERE id=#{id} AND verification_status='pending' AND version=#{version}
